cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(goose_regex_native LANGUAGES C)
find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)
pkg_check_modules(PCRE2 REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET libpcre2-8>=10.42)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
add_library(goose_regex_native STATIC native/regex.c)
set_target_properties(goose_regex_native PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_compile_features(goose_regex_native PRIVATE c_std_11)
target_compile_options(goose_regex_native PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
target_link_libraries(goose_regex_native PUBLIC PkgConfig::PCRE2 Threads::Threads)
